name: guideme-monorepo
description: Universal Tutorial Engine — Browser Extension and Headless Engine Monorepo

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs'; ['node_modules', 'apps/chrome-extension/node_modules', 'packages/adapter-interface/node_modules', 'packages/chrome-adapter/node_modules', 'packages/core-types/node_modules', 'packages/engine/node_modules', 'packages/tutorial-schema/node_modules', 'packages/tutorial-ui/node_modules', 'apps/chrome-extension/.output', 'apps/chrome-extension/.wxt'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })); console.log('Cleaned build artifacts successfully.');"
